Relay launch review

Relay went to every workspace on October 6. Two weeks in, activation is back to where it was before the September dip, and invites are the reason. This page is where we decide what ships next.

Decision: keep the new invite flow and drop the old one on November 3.

What changed

  • Invites send from the workspace's own address, so they land in the inbox.
  • A new member sees the page they were invited to first, not an empty home.
  • The welcome checklist shrank from seven steps to three.

Interview notes

Five of eight new members said the invite email was the first thing they read from us. Three never found it.

Nobody missed the old welcome steps.
